blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.
blocks.zh: 多伦多大学航空航天小组空间系统司开发的作物残留超光谱绘图野外成像纳米卫星(FINCH)的光谱范围对超光谱解析以确定作物残留覆盖分数丰度构成重大挑战。 由于严重缺乏标准指数,必须使用复杂、数据驱动的不混合模型。 复杂的不混合模型需要密集、分布良好的多面体,而地面真实数据集则稀少且昂贵。 为了更好地利用现有地面真实数据集中的信息内容,本研究提出了一个框架,通过中间有条件的数据生成器,与传统的单一模式的不混合管道形成对比,使插值和丰度映射估算脱钩。 这种脱钩可以包含关于光谱的先天物理知识,而光谱在本土是无法被解混模型所获取的,从而人为地扩大数据集,作为人口风险的蒙特卡洛近似值. 为了测试这一假说,我们提出了两种生成模型:一种是带有Conformer Layles(GD-Streamline)的1D条件U-Net,一种是双帕变换器条件Variational AutoEncoder(TCVAE),另一种是两种不混合模型:多拉耶雷德受体(MLP)和Fourier神经操作器(FNO). 研究结果表明,需要在拟议的脱钩框架范围内严格整合和引入光谱前科,以防止域和模式崩溃和生成模型产生幻觉;否则,这会导致错误的近似数据复数,最终导致不满意和分散的不混合性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The University of Toronto Aerospace Team’s (UTAT) Space Systems Division is developing the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral mapping (FINCH) CubeSat, a mission focusing on crop residue cover (CRC) mapping using the 900–1700 nm (SWIR1) spectral range. As such, a core objective for FINCH’s Science team is to develop a hyperspectral unmixing pipeline for the given spectral range and to determine the high-level engineering requirements for FINCH’s payload and bus teams. The spectral range available to FINCH rules out the use of well-known indices, as there are no significant spectral features. As a result, FINCH’s Science team has been developing statistical, machine, and deep learning-based models, given their growing promise for CRC estimation [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 多伦多大学航空航天队(UTAT) 空间系统司正在研制用于作物残留量超光谱绘图(FINCH)CubeSat的野外成像纳米卫星,该任务的重点是利用900至1700纳米(SWIR1)光谱范围绘制作物残留量覆盖量。 因此,FINCH科学小组的一个核心目标是为给定的光谱范围开发一个超光谱分解管道,并确定FINCH的有效载荷和总线组的高水平工程要求。 FINCH可用的光谱范围排除了有名的指数的使用,因为没有显著的光谱特征. 因此,FINCH的科学小组一直在开发统计、机器和以学习为基础的深层模型,因为它们对CRC估计的承诺越来越大[8]。

blocks.en: However, developing such data-driven unmixing models requires dense, high-quality, and well-distributed datasets that are similar to the data that would be downlinked from FINCH in terms of atmospheric effects. To simulate the effects caused by the atmosphere, the team has increasingly focused on developing an atmospheric modeling and inversion pipeline using the ground-truth dataset. Additionally, such datasets must have a dense, wide distribution over abundance (and consequently spectral) space, so that the data-driven model has readily accessible information for proper training. However, a gap remains in the density and distribution of the current ground-truth dataset used by the Science team [ 2 ] , and this gap similarly persists in various hyperspectral remote sensing applications [ 8 ] . The low density and improper distribution of the pre-existing datasets used by the Science team become a roadblock for some high-capacity data-driven unmixing models.
blocks.zh: 然而,开发这种由数据驱动的无混合模型需要密集、高质量和分布良好的数据集,这些数据集与在大气效应方面与FINCH下行连接的数据类似。 为了模拟大气层所造成的后果,该小组越来越注重利用地面真实数据集开发大气模型和反演管道。 此外,这类数据集必须在丰度空间(因此也是光谱空间)上有密集而广泛的分布,以便数据驱动的模型能够随时获得适当的培训信息。 然而,科学小组目前使用的地面真实数据集在密度和分布方面仍存在差距,在各种高光谱遥感应用中,这种差距也同样存在。 科学小组使用的原有数据集密度低而分布不当,成为了某些高容量数据驱动的不混合模型的路障.

blocks.en: Addressing this data gap traditionally requires either developing highly data-efficient hyperspectral unmixing algorithms that better exploit the information available in the datasets or conducting extensive, logistically complex, and financially expensive ground-truth data-collection missions. We propose a new pipeline as a solution, contingent on the system’s physics and requiring complex hyperspectral unmixing algorithms, but lacking expansive, well-distributed datasets.
blocks.zh: 解决这一数据差距,传统上需要要么开发高数据效率的超光谱分解算法,以更好地利用数据集中的信息,要么开展范围广泛、后勤复杂、费用昂贵的地面真实数据收集任务。 我们提出一个新的管道作为解决方案,这取决于系统物理,并且需要复杂的超光谱分解算法,但缺乏扩展的分布良好的数据集。

blocks.en: The described solution aims to increase the overall efficiency of the hyperspectral unmixing pipeline by decoupling spectral interpolation and spectra-to-abundance mapping into two separate models: a data generator trained on the ground-truth dataset to synthesize spectra, and an unmixing model trained on the synthesized spectra. We propose that, under certain conditions that also apply to the FINCH mission, such decoupling can, in theory, make the information content in ground-truth datasets much more readily accessible to unmixing models.
blocks.zh: 所描述的解决方案旨在通过分解光谱插入和光谱到丰度映射两种独立的模型来提高超光谱解相管的整体效率:一个在地面-真实数据集上训练以合成光谱的数据生成器,另一个在合成光谱上训练以合成光谱的解相模型. 我们建议,在同样适用于FINCH任务的某些条件下,这种脱钩在理论上可以使地面真实数据集中的信息内容更容易为解密模型所利用。

blocks.en: Following previous architectural screenings of various models and frameworks, the study has refined its focus to two architectures: a Gaussian Diffusion model (specifically, a Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model) based on a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers, and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder. This study uses a larger spectral range that is not available to FINCH (400–2490 nm) for the training of the generator model, to make use of a higher amount of information available in the wider spectral range, to resolve specific, yet not very significant, spectral features that are available in FINCH’s spectral range, 900–1700 nm, SWIR1.
blocks.zh: 在以往对各种模型和框架进行建筑筛选后,该研究将重点调整为两种建筑:一种是高斯散化模型(具体来说,是Denoising Divusion Implicial Model),以带有Conformer Lays的1D Conditional U-Net为基础;一种是双相变相器 Conditional Variational Auto Encoder. 本研究利用FINCH(400–2490 nm)所不具备的较大光谱范围来培训生成器模型,利用在更宽光谱范围内可获得的更高数量的信息,解决FINCH的光谱范围900–1700 nm,SWIR1中存在的具体而并非非常重要的光谱特征.

blocks.en: 2 Theory
blocks.zh: 2个 理论

blocks.en: In the theory section, we formalize and provide reasoning for the proposed decoupling of interpolation and spectra-to-abundance mapping within the proposed pipeline. We hypothesize that by isolating the two tasks of interpolation and spectrum-to-abundance mapping, additional spectral information and physical prior knowledge can be used, thereby aiding learning of the physical interactions among spectral bands and the underlying constraints of the hyperspectral unmixing problem. Furthermore, we address, at the end of this section, the information-theoretic implications of the decoupled pipeline, specifically within the context of the Data Processing Inequality.
blocks.zh: 在理论部分,我们正式确定了拟议中线内插图和光谱到丰度绘图的脱钩办法,并提出了理由。 我们假设,通过隔离插图和频谱至丰富度绘图这两个任务,可以使用额外的光谱信息和物理前知识,从而帮助学习光谱波段之间的物理相互作用以及超光谱分解问题的根本限制。 此外,在本节末尾,我们具体在数据处理不平等的背景下,讨论脱钩管道的信息理论影响。

blocks.en: 2.4 The Role of Inductive Biases and the Data Processing Inequality
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 诱导工具的作用与数据处理不平等

blocks.en: We note that any model or algorithm that processes data is bound by the Data Processing Inequality (DPI), which applies to the proposed decoupling by imposing an upper bound on the mutual information between a learned representation of G G and the abundance labels, M n M_{n} , while training a generator model G G , which acts as an information content bottleneck. However, it must be acknowledged that DPI explicitly applies to the information content available, not necessarily to its accessibility or representational utility. The decoupled pipeline allows the introduction of several spectral priors, such as the SAM, TV, and FFT. Such spectral priors cannot be directly applied to the predictions of unmixing models and are not always accessible to them through architectural implementations, since, without knowing the exact mixing model of the system involved, a spectrum cannot be reconstructed to apply them.

blocks.en: 3 Generative Model Definitions
blocks.zh: 3 基因模型定义

blocks.en: While initial conceptualizations and explorations for the generative model G G included standard Conditional Convolutional AutoEncoders (C-CVAE), Conditional Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks (C-WGAN), and Conditional Diffusion Transformers (C-DiT), the preliminary testing provided several challenges. The C-CVAE models were prone to mode collapse, C-WGANs had severe convergence difficulties, and C-DiT models suffered from vanishing gradients due to their deep architectures. Consequently, the preliminary architectures either underwent design iterations or were discontinued due to the higher technical demands posed by conditional generative models. C-CVAE architectures were evolved into a novel Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder architecture to mitigate over-smoothing and mode collapse; C-DiT models were reformed into a Gaussian Diffusion model (DDIM) based on a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers to mitigate vanishing gradients and denoising artifacts. The models defined in this section were selected for their high theoretical capacity and flexibility to include physical priors to better approximate the underlying data manifold given the constraints detailed in Section 2 .
blocks.zh: 虽然基因模型G的初始概念化和探索包括了标准的有条件的革命自动编码器(C-CVAE),有条件的Wasserstein Generative Aversarial Networks(C-WGAN)和有条件的分化变形器(C-DIT),但初步测试提供了几个挑战. C-CVAE模型容易发生模式倒塌,C-WGANs有严重的汇合困难,而C-DIT模型因其深层架构而发生梯度消失. 因此,初步建筑要么进行了设计迭代,要么由于有条件的基因模型对技术要求较高而中止。 C-CVAE架构被演化为一款新颖的"双相变相器条件变相"(Dual-Path Transformer Contitional Auto Encoder architecture)来缓解过度流出和模式倒塌;C-DiT模型被改革为高斯扩散模型(DDIM),以1D的"条件变相"(Contitional U-Net)与"前地层"(Conformer Tlayers)为基础来缓解已消失的梯度和去诺文物. 之所以选择本节所定义的模型,是因为这些模型具有很高的理论能力和灵活性,以包括物理前科,从而考虑到第2节所详述的制约因素,更好地大致了解基本数据。

The fused conditions are then forward propagated through an MLP with SiLU activations to yield a unified global embedding that modulates the U-Net feature maps.
blocks.zh: 如图1所显示的,网络调制通过元素相加,分别将scalar扩散时间步和丰度矢量在sinusoid位置嵌入和投影后融合. 然后通过一个带有SiLU活化的MLP将已引信的条件向前传播,以产生一个统一的全球嵌入,来调制U-Net特征图。

blocks.en: The U-Net processes the input tensor constructed by concatenating the 1D sensor input (spectra) and the noisy spectral input. The architecture employs a symmetric hierarchy of down-blocks, mid-blocks, and up-blocks, connected by residual skip connections. Each layer employs ResNet1D blocks to integrate global abundance embeddings and uses Conformer layers to capture global features based on abundances and diffusion time steps.
blocks.zh: U-Net处理通过调取1D传感器输入(光谱)和噪音光谱输入所构建的输入收发器. 该建筑采用下行区块,中行区块和上行区块的对称分级,由剩余跳跃连接相接. 每层都使用ResNet1D块来整合全球丰度嵌入,并使用Conformer地层来捕捉基于丰度和扩散时间步骤的全球特征.

blocks.en: The model denoises using a deterministic DDIM logic, which is amplified by classifier-free guidance during sampling and inference. Training minimizes a composite loss function that combines the standard L2 loss for noise prediction with physical priors on reconstructed spectra: spectral angle (SAM), L1 loss on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) magnitudes, and Total Variation (TV). During training, the conditioning is occasionally dropped, enabling the model to learn to produce an unconditional output.
blocks.zh: 模型外观采用定型DDIM逻辑,在采样和推论过程中通过无分级指导来放大. 训练能将用于噪声预测的标准L2损失与重建光谱上的物理前兆相结合的复合损失函数最小化:光谱角度(SAM),快变速器(FFT)等分量上L1损失,和总变相(TV). 在训练期间,偶尔会降调,使模型能够学习产生无条件的输出.

blocks.en: Ablation studies on architectural hyperparameters revealed that stacking multiple Conformer blocks within each ResNet1D block led to vanishing gradients, weakening visual heuristic performance during training. As such, restricting the architectures to employ a single Conformer block per ResNet1D module maximized the residual-to-computational-layer ratio, thereby mitigating gradient attenuation and improving convergence. Additionally, the number of ResNet1D blocks per level without the introduction of frequent residual connections hindered signal propagation and the learning of fine-grained features. As a result, the finalized architecture, employing one ResNet1D block per layer and one Conformer layer for each ResNet1D block, was named “GD-Streamline”.
blocks.zh: 对建筑超参数的研究显示,在每个ResNet1D区块内堆放多块Conformer区块,导致梯度消失,削弱了训练期间的视觉高压性能. 因此,限制建筑每个ResNet1D模块使用单个Conformer区块,使剩余至计算层次的比例最大化,从而减轻梯度减弱并改进了趋同. 此外,没有引入频繁的剩余连接的每个关卡的ResNet1D区块数量阻碍了信号传播和精细特性的学习。 因此,最后敲定的架构采用每层一个ResNet1D区块和每个ResNet1D区块一个Conformer地块,被命名为"GD-Streamline".

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder
blocks.zh: 3.2 二相变形器 有条件的变量自动编码器

blocks.en: Figure 2: Architecture of Dual-Path TCVAE.
blocks.zh: 图2:双帕TCVAE结构.

blocks.en: Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (Dual-Path TCVAE, referred to as TCVAE throughout this study) is the main AutoEncoder-based architecture we propose. Our earlier empirical results show a tendency for the Transformer and Conditional-VAE architectures to over-smooth the output, as the decoder relies entirely on the conditioning values for green vegetation, non-photosynthetic vegetation, and soil. To solve this, we propose a dual-path decoder: the global path uses condition values, and the local path uses only latent variables.
blocks.zh: 双面变形器 有条件的变相自动编码器(德語:Dual-Path TCVAE,通称为TCVAE)是我们提出的以自动编码器为基础的主要架构. 我们早期的经验结果表明,变形器和条件-VAE架构倾向于过度平分输出,因为解码器完全依赖于绿色植被、非相合成植被和土壤的调节值。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个双路径解码器:全球路径使用条件值,而局部路径只使用潜在变量.

blocks.en: Specifically, our encoder consists of an MLP projection for class conditions and spectrum tokens, which are then fed into 6 Transformer blocks, followed by pooling and projection to the Gaussian distribution. Each Transformer block consists of a standard multi-head attention module with RMS Norm for feature extraction, followed by cross-attention with condition embeddings, and a final latent extraction using an MLP head. Our decoder consists of two branches: a global path and a local path. The global path is a 2-layer MLP that processes the condition embedding. The local path consists of a linear latent projection, followed by a sinusoidal projection, then 2 decoder transformer blocks, and finally another learned linear projection. We fuse these global & local spectra with learnable weights and a configurable warm-up scale. The architecture details can be found in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们的编码器由分类条件和频谱符号的MLP投影组成,然后被输入到6个变形器块中,然后集合并投影到高斯分布. 每个变形器块由标准多头注意模块组成,RMS Norm用于特性提取,再用条件嵌入来交叉注意,再用 MLP 头来进行最终潜取. 我们的解码器由两个分支组成:一条全球路径和一条地方路径. 全球路径是一个2层的MLP,它处理条件嵌入. 局部路径由线性潜射而成,再由线性潜射而成,再由2个解码器变压器块组成,最后是另一个有学识的线性投射. 我们把这些全球和本地光谱 与可学习的重量和可变的温暖相融合 建筑细节见图2.

blocks.en: 4 Test Metric Definitions
blocks.zh: 4 测试计量定义

blocks.en: 4.1 Nearest Neighbor
blocks.zh: 4.1 近邻

blocks.en: We present a metric that quantifies how well the generated and ground-truth samples spread across each other’s distributions, given the absence of pre-existing metrics for quantifying manifold approximation. The metric uses the nearest neighbors (defined by a distance metric) of a curated subset of ground-truth samples to generate samples. The dataset used for validation and testing during the generator’s training was split into two distinct subsets, with the abundances of one subset used to generate spectra as generation conditions. The spectra were combined into an adjacency matrix with a directed 1-nearest-neighbor mapping to determine which spectra in a column had which spectra in a row as their nearest neighbors. Such an adjacency matrix allows the analysis of approximate distributions of the generated spectra within the ground-truth dataset by creating a network of nearest-neighbor relations, enabling the quantification of generation bias and variance. Two distance metrics, Euclidean and spectral angle, were used to identify the closest neighbors of each point, enabling detailed quantification of spectral amplitude and shape similarity, respectively.

blocks.en: 4.2 Hyperspectral Unmixing Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 超光谱解混模型

blocks.en: We proposed several unmixing models for initial screening using the ground-truth dataset. Based on the ground-truth dataset, we filtered the models and selected two to test on the generated datasets to assess the validity of the decoupling proposal. We primarily quantified the models’ accuracies using the mean R 2 R^{2} (also called total R 2 R^{2} ) of predicted versus actual abundance across the three endmember classes. This initial screening was conducted in the full spectral range available: 400-2490 nm.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了几种使用地真相数据集进行初步筛选的未混合模型。 根据地面真实数据集,我们过滤了模型,并选定两个模型对生成的数据集进行测试,以评估脱钩建议的有效性. 我们主要使用三个最终成员类别中预测与实际丰度的平均值R 2 R^{2}(也称为总R 2 R^{2})来量化模型的精度。 初步筛选是在全光谱范围内进行的:400-2490纳米。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Multi-Layered Perceptron:
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 多种语言 觉道:

blocks.en: As a baseline, we use a fully-connected MLP that directly maps the 210-band vector to the three abundances. We have implemented two MLP architectures, where the first, MLP-S, has two hidden layers: the first with 64 neurons and the second with 32 neurons (each followed by ReLU activations). This yields a lightweight model ( ∼ \sim 16k parameters) compared to the CNN and FNO (which have millions of parameters). The second model, MLP-M, implemented four layers of 128 neurons, with dropout, LeakyReLU, and batch normalization applied after each layer. The second model provided a further baseline for a more complex (compared to the first proposed MLP) model, with a relatively higher learnable parameter count ( ∼ \sim 61k). All MLP models’ output layers are linear projections to 3 units, representing the abundances. Despite its lack of complex model layers, the MLP provides a point of comparison for how well a non-spatial model can learn the unmixing task.
blocks.zh: 作为基线,我们使用一个完全连接的MLP,直接将210波段向量映射到三个丰度. 我们实施了两个MLP架构,其中第一个是MLP-S,有两个隐藏层:第一个是64个神经元;第二个是32个神经元(每个神经元后面是ReLU活化). 与有线电视新闻网和FNO(有上百万个参数)相比,这产生了一个轻量级模型(\\\ sim 16k参数). 第二个模型是MLP-M,它执行了四层128个神经元,退学了,LeakyReLU,批量正常化在每层之后适用. 第二种模式为更复杂的模式提供了进一步的基准(与第一个提议的MLP相比),可学习参数数相对较高(\\sim 61k)。 MLP模型的所有输出层都是线性预测到3个单元,代表丰度. 尽管缺少复杂的模型层,MLP为非空间模型如何能很好地学习去混合的任务提供了一个比较点.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Convolutional Neural Network:
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 革命神经网络:

blocks.en: The CNN treats each input spectrum as a one-channel 1D sequence and processes it through repeated convolutional stages, optionally with residual refinement with batch normalization in the reported configurations, GELU activation, and dropout in both the convolutional blocks and the output head, with optional residual blocks that add skip connections around pairs of convolutional blocks. Each stage ends with average pooling followed by adaptive average pooling and a small MLP head that outputs abundance fractions. CNN-M uses 3 convolution stages (64–256 filters, kernel size 7) and one residual block per stage. CNN-L increases depth by using two residual blocks per stage and width (96–384 filters), with 8% dropout. CNN-XL adds a fourth convolutional stage, wider filters (up to 512), larger kernels (size 9), and 10% dropout. Residual blocks are enabled across all reported CNN variants.
blocks.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网将每个输入频谱作为一通道一维序列处理,并经过反复的回旋相继阶段,可选择性地进行剩余改进,在报告的配置中进行批量正常化,GELU活化,在回旋相继的块和输出相继被淘汰,可选择性地添加绕相继回旋相继相继的回旋相继连接. 每个阶段最后都是平均集合,然后是适应性平均集合和一个输出丰量分量的小型MLP头. CNN-M采用3个演化相(64–256个滤波器,内核大小为7个)和每个相相片上一个残块. CNN-L通过使用每个阶段和宽度(96–384个滤波器)的两个剩余块来增加深度,其中退学率为8%. CNN-XL新增了第四演化阶段,更宽的滤波器(可达512个),更宽的内核(9个大小)和10%的退学率. 所有报道的CNN变体都启用了残余区块.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Fourier Neural Operator:
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 傅里叶神经操作员:

blocks.en: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) model employs global convolution via Fourier transforms to capture long-range spectral patterns [ 4 ] . Given that spectra have long-range spectral patterns themselves due to the emission bands of different materials, we chose FNO as a candidate. It treats the input as a 1D signal and performs spectral convolution in the frequency domain. The medium FNO (FNO-M) consists of 4 Fourier blocks with a hidden width of 128 and uses the lowest 32 frequency modes in each layer. The large FNO (FNO-L) maintains 4 blocks but expands to a width of 192 and 48 Fourier modes. The extra-large FNO (FNO-XL) uses 5 blocks, 256 feature width, and 64 modes. All FNO variants apply a global mean pooling before the output layer (no local pooling between layers) and do not use dropout. Like the CNN, the FNO’s final layer is a linear projection to the 3 abundance values.
blocks.zh: Fourier神经操作器(FNO)模型通过Fourier变换使用全球分解来捕捉远程光谱图案[4]. 鉴于光谱由于不同材料的排放带而具有长程光谱图案本身,我们选择了FNO作为候选. 它将输入作为一维信号处理,并在频率域中进行光谱分解. 中FNO (FNO-M)由4个傅里叶区块组成,隐藏宽度为128个并使用每层最低的32个频率模式. 大型FNO(FNO-L)维持了4个区块,但扩展至192和48个傅里叶模式. 外大的FNO(FNO-XL)使用5个区块,256个地物宽度,64个模式. 所有FNO变体在输出层之前都应用了全局平均集合(在层之间没有局部集合),并且不使用退出. 与CNN一样,FNO的最后一层是线性投影到3丰度值.

blocks.en: 5 Ground-Truth Dataset Results
blocks.zh: 5 地对地数据集结果

blocks.en: We begin by evaluating how well different architectures perform spectral unmixing when trained on ground-truth data. This serves as a baseline: our ultimate goal is to compare these results with models trained on synthesized data to assess whether a learned synthesizer can replace or augment scarce ground-truth labels, and to use this baseline to choose which unmixing models to test further.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估不同结构在接受地面真实数据培训时如何进行光谱解密。 这可作为基线:我们的最终目标是将这些结果同经过综合数据培训的模型进行比较,以评估一个已学习的合成器是否可以取代或扩充稀缺的地真标签,并利用这一基线来选择哪些未混合模型进一步测试。

blocks.en: All models were trained on the dataset under comparable settings (using the same train, validation, and testing split and up to 80 epochs of training with early stopping). The R 2 R^{2} values were the primary metric of interest, as they provide a relevant statistical measure of how well an unmixing model performs.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都接受了关于可比设置下的数据集的培训(使用同一列车、验证和测试,分出最多80个培训时代,提前停止)。 R 2 R^{2}的数值是主要的衡量标准,因为这些数值提供了一个相关的统计尺度,用以衡量未混合模型的运作情况。

blocks.en:
The FNO models achieved the highest overall accuracy, as indicated by their high total R 2 R^{2} values. FNO-L and FNO-XL achieved the lowest test MSE ( ∼ \sim 0.0084–0.0087) and the highest total R 2 R^{2} ( ∼ \sim 0.91), outperforming both CNN and MLP variants. A clear scaling trend appears: increasing model size from FNO-M to FNO-L notably improved accuracy, while FNO-XL offered smaller additional gains. This suggests that FNO benefits from larger capacity, though with diminishing returns at the XL scale.
The CNN models showed the opposite trend: CNN-M achieved the best test total R 2 R^{2} ( ∼ \sim 0.86), while larger models like CNN-L and CNN-XL performed worse, with CNN-XL dropping to  0.79. This suggests that increasing CNN capacity led to only slightly greater overfitting rather than improved generalization. All CNNs were still improving near the end of training (best epochs around 75–76 out of 80), thus larger models may have benefited from further tuning.
blocks.zh:
FNO模型实现了最高的总精度,其高总分R 2 R^{2}值就表明了这一点. FNO-L和FNO-XL实现了最低测试的MSE(\sim 0.0084–0.0087)和最高的总R 2 R^{2} (\sim 0.91),均优于CNN和MLP的变体. 明显的趋势是:模型大小从FNO-M增加到FNO-L,其准确性明显提高,而FNO-XL带来的额外收益较小。 这表明FNO从更大的容量中获益,尽管XL规模的回报不断减少.
CNN模型显示相反的趋势:CNN-M实现了最佳测试总R 2 R^{2} (\\\ sim 0.86),而更大型的模型如CNN-L和CNN-XL表现更差,CNN-XL则下降到了0.79. 这表明,CNN容量的提高仅导致略为大的过度适应,而不是改善通俗化. 所有有线电视新闻网在培训接近尾声时仍在改进(80个中有75-76个是最佳时代),因此,更大的模型可能得益于进一步的调整。

blocks.en: The MLP-S baseline reached a test total R 2 R^{2} of ∼ \sim 0.88, comparable to CNN-M and close to the FNO models. Additionally, the MLP-M baseline model reached a test total R 2 R^{2} of ∼ \sim 0.89. Despite lacking explicit spectral convolution, the MLP models performed competitively on the per-pixel unmixing task, suggesting that much of the task can be learned without it. However, the FNO’s ability to capture more global spectral structure gave it an edge in accuracy.
blocks.zh: MLP-S基线达到测试总R 2 R^{2} \\ sim 0.88,与CNN-M相当并接近FNO模型. 此外,MLP-M基线模型达到试验总R 2 R^{2}为\sim 0.89。 尽管缺乏明确的光谱分解,MLP模型在每像素解混任务上进行了竞争性的演绎,表明没有它,大部分任务可以学习. 然而,FNO能够捕捉到更多的全球光谱结构,使得它具有精度的边缘.

blocks.en: Across all models, we observed minimal overfitting. The generalization gaps were very small (on the order of 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), indicating that validation and training errors remained close. Even the largest models (CNN-XL, FNO-XL) showed only a slight increase in gap ( ∼ 0.005 − 0.007 \sim 0.005-0.007 MSE), and in earlier 80-epoch experiments, some gaps were essentially zero or negative. These tiny gaps suggest no severe overfitting, suggesting that the models may have benefited from additional training. In summary, the FNO architecture delivered the best unmixing performance in our experiments, while the CNN and MLP provided strong baselines. The results also highlight that model scaling can have different effects: FNO gains from scaling (up to saturation), whereas the CNN requires further tuning or longer training to benefit from increased capacity.
blocks.zh: 在所有的模型中,我们观察到 最小的超合。 概括性差距很小(大约为10-3-10-X-3),表明验证和培训错误仍然很接近。 即使最大的模型(CNN-XL,FNO-XL)也只显示差距略有增加(∼0.005-0.007\sim 0.005-0.07 MSE),在早期的80世纪实验中,一些差距基本上是零或负的. 这些微小的差距表明,这些模式没有严重过度调整,表明这些模式可能已经受益于更多的培训。 简而言之,FNO架构在我们的实验中提供了最佳的不混合性能,而CNN和MLP则提供了强大的基线. 研究结果还凸显出模型缩放可以产生不同的效果:FNO从缩放(提升到饱和度)得到收益,而CNN则需要进一步调整或更长时间的培训来从能力的提高中获益.

blocks.en: Given these results, we selected FNO-XL and MLP-M as the primary unmixing models for evaluating synthesis-based training, as they have the highest overall accuracy, and training will be conducted on dedicated hardware. The FNO-XL model was selected primarily because of its high complexity and its ability to achieve the highest total R 2 R^{2} values in testing. Additionally, MLP-M was chosen for achieving reasonable total R 2 R^{2} values and lower complexity. The disparity in complexity between the two models was deliberately chosen to test one of the assumptions of the proposed decoupling framework, as stated in Section 2.5 .
blocks.zh: 鉴于这些结果,我们选择了FNO-XL和MLP-M作为评价以合成为基础的培训的主要不混合模型,因为这些模型具有最高的总体准确性,并将就专用硬件进行培训。 FNO-XL模型之所以被选中,主要是因为其高度复杂,在测试中能够达到最高的总R 2 R^{2}值. 此外,选择MLP-M是为了达到合理的总R 2 R^{2}值并降低复杂性。 如第2.5节所指出,为了检验拟议脱钩框架的假设之一,有意选择了两种模式之间复杂性的差异。

blocks.en: 7.1 Manifold Approximation and Domain Collapse
blocks.zh: 7.1 人工耳蜗近似和域叠

blocks.en: The Gaussian Diffusion Streamline (GD-Streamline) model consistently underperformed in both manifold approximation and, consequently, performance yield within the decoupling framework. Although heuristically the GD-Streamline models produce noisy spectra that resemble the ground-truth dataset spectra, the δ \delta -nearest-neighbor metric strongly indicates severe domain collapse, failing to approximate the ground-truth dataset’s underlying manifold. Across different nearest-neighbor distance definitions, the metrics did not change drastically, indicating a severe domain collapse in both spectral shape features and amplitudes. Such a collapse indicates that the TV, SAM, and FFT physical priors did not provide a significant benefit beyond heuristic improvements. As indicated by the ζ \zeta metric, the GD-Streamline also hallucinates to some extent; with a negative ϵ \epsilon indicating a form of mode collapse, in which generated spectra tend to be more clumped than in the ground-truth dataset.
blocks.zh: 高斯扩散流线(GD-Streamline)模式在多相近和因此在脱钩框架内的性能产量方面一直表现不佳。 虽然GD-Streamline模型的推力可以产生类似地真数据集光谱的响亮光谱,但\\delta-近邻的度量衡强烈表明域域严重崩溃,未能接近地真数据集的基础多面体。 不同近邻距离定义的衡量尺度没有发生剧烈变化,表明光谱外形特征和振幅都出现了严重的域崩溃。 这样的倒闭表明,电视、SAM和FFT物理前科并没有提供超出热度改进的重大好处。 如QQ\zeta 度量法所显示,GD-Streamline在一定程度上也会产生幻觉;负QQ\epsilon表示一种模式崩溃的形式,在这种模式下产生的光谱往往比地面-真实数据集更发光.

blocks.en: As stated in Section 6.1 , the TCVAE model underperformed in manifold approximation, comparatively worse than the GD-Streamline model. With the disparity in δ \delta metrics defining domain collapse, which changes dramatically with different distance definitions, indicating that the TCVAE model lacked the necessary physical priors to correctly approximate the spectral manifold underlying their features. Additionally, with the comparatively high ϵ \epsilon metric, it is evident that the TCVAE model experienced severe domain collapse, resulting in most spectra collapsing into a specific spectral region and possibly leading to hallucinations, as shown by the ζ \zeta metric. Although the TCVAE model presented superior heuristics compared to GD-Streamline, it was plagued by small-scale noise, as indicated by nearest-neighbor metrics, and its manifold approximation was comparatively worse.
blocks.zh: 如第6.1节所指出,TCVAE模型在多重近似方面表现不佳,比GD-Streamline模型要差。 \\delta 度量法中定义域崩溃的差别很大,它随不同距离定义而发生巨大变化,表明TCVAE模型缺乏必要的物理前兆,无法正确估计其特征所基于的光谱多面. 此外,由于QQ\epsilon 度量衡比较高,TCVAE模型显然经历了严重的域崩溃,导致大多数光谱分解为特定的光谱区并可能导致幻觉,如QQ\zeta 度量衡所示. 虽然TCVAE模型与GD-Streamline相比呈现出优异的heuristics,但正如近邻的度量衡所示,它受到小范围噪音的困扰,其多相近性相对更差.

blocks.en: 7.2 Unmixing Performance and Accuracy Yield of Decoupling
blocks.zh: 7.2 脱钩性能和准确性

blocks.en: Given the severe implications of the nearest-neighbor metrics applied to GD-Streamline, the decoupling yields, as expected, severe unmixing inaccuracies. With the implication of high δ \delta , that the learned physics and underlying manifold are different from the ground-truth, the unmixing models have consequently created a mapping between nonphysical, or at best, wrongly approximated manifolds. Given the severe domain collapse, the similarity in failure magnitudes between the FNO and MLP unmixing models was expected.
blocks.zh: 鉴于对GD-Streamline采用的最近邻接度量的严重影响,如所料,脱钩的产量严重不相混合。 由于高分 \\ delta 的影响,即所学的物理学和基础的多面性与地面真实性不同,因此,不相混合的模型在非物理或最多是错误的近似多面性之间产生了一种映射。 鉴于严重的域倒闭,预计FNO和MLP的解相模型在故障分量上是相似的.

blocks.en: In contrast to the comparatively worse manifold approximation metrics, the TCVAE model achieved much higher accuracy in decoupling than the GD-Streamline model. Although the TCVAE model showed worse domain collapse than GD-Streamline, the much higher accuracy achieved with decoupling suggests the possibility of localized mode collapse. Given the significantly high clumping of generated spectra, the domain collapse, hallucination, low NPV R 2 R^{2} accuracy, yet relatively high Total R 2 R^{2} accuracy, it is plausible that the TCVAE model has learned and domain collapsed on a narrow section of the ground-truth manifold ℳ n \mathcal{M}_{n} . Additionally, the disparity in the increasing size of the generated dataset’s effect on FNO and MLP model predictions, with a positive and negative effect, respectively, indicates that the high-capacity unmixing model requirement stated in Section 2.5 can be met to an extent by an FNO architecture.
blocks.zh: 与相对更差的多相近似度测量相比,TCVAE模型在脱钩方面的精度远高于GD-Streamline模型. 虽然TCVAE模型显示出比GD-Streamline更糟糕的域倒闭,但通过脱钩实现的精度要高得多,表明有可能出现局部模式倒闭. 鉴于生成光谱的发光率显著高,域断裂,幻觉,低NPV R 2 R^{2}精度高,但总R 2 R^{2}精度高,TCVAE模型在地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地-地-地-地-地---地-地--地--地-地--地-地-地---地--------地---- 此外,生成的数据集对FNO和MLP模型预测的影响越来越大,其影响分别为正向和负向,这种差异表明,第2.5节所述的大容量无混合模型要求可以在一定程度上通过FNO架构得到满足。

blocks.en: 7.3 Limitations of the Study
blocks.zh: 7.3 研究的局限性

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Computational Limitations:
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 计算限制:

blocks.en: The scope of this study was inherently constrained by the computational resources available. Such a limitation naturally constrained the exploration of the scaling of the two generative model architectures, in terms of the total number of learnable parameters and the number of trained epochs. As a result, the models were naturally not scaled to an extent in terms of learnable parameters and training epochs to reasonably observe the effect of double-descent [ 7 ] , which through the asymptotic reduction of training losses for both U U and G G models, can in theory reduce both ϵ a ​ p ​ p ​ ( U ) \epsilon_{app}(U) and ϵ g ​ e ​ n \epsilon_{gen} . Given that reaching the second-descent regime for deep generative architectures such as those employed in this study is often critical for generalization [ 3 ] , it is theoretically possible that the models in this study lacked the necessary capacity or training duration to reach it. Additionally, due to limited computational resources, observing the asymptotic behavior of the dataset size ( k k ) as it increased was constrained.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的范围必然受到现有计算资源的制约。 这种限制自然制约了对两个基因模型结构规模的探索,从可学习参数的总数和训练有素的时代数量来看. 因此,这些模型自然没有在可学习的参数和培训时期达到一定程度,以合理观察双衰期[7]的影响,通过对U U和G模型的不对称减少培训损失,理论上可以减少一个p(U)\epsilon_{app}(U)和Q(g) e n\epsilon_{gen}。 鉴于本研究中采用的深分结构达到第二代制度对于概括化往往至关重要[3],因此,本研究中的模型理论上可能缺乏达到这一年龄的必要能力或培训期限。 此外,由于计算资源有限,观察数据集大小(k k)的不对称行为受到制约。

blocks.en: 7.3.2 Ground-Truth Dataset Heterogeneity:
blocks.zh: 7.3.2 地对地数据集 异质性 :

blocks.en: Furthermore, the ground-truth dataset utilized throughout the study for training, validation, and testing presents significant challenges due to its inherent heterogeneity. The dataset, an aggregation of six individual studies, exhibits inherently different mixing physics and abundance distributions, suggesting the possibility of a highly discontinuous or volatile underlying ground-truth dataset manifold ℳ n \mathcal{M}_{n} . Covariate shift and distributional mismatches, given the dataset heterogeneity, could have theoretically increased both bias terms ( ϵ a ​ p ​ p ​ ( U ) \epsilon_{app}(U) and ϵ g ​ e ​ n \epsilon_{gen} ) and the risk minimization term on the generated dataset ( R ^ k ​ ( U ) \widehat{R}_{k}(U) ). A ground-truth dataset with less heterogeneity could, in theory, have yielded better manifold approximation metrics and a stronger decoupling effect.
blocks.zh: 此外,整个研究中用于培训、验证和测试的地上真象数据集由于其固有的异同性而构成重大挑战。 数据集由6个单独研究汇总而成,显示物理和丰度分布的内在差异,表明可能出现高度不连续性或多变性的地基-真实数据集多维M n mathcal{M}_{n}。 鉴于数据集的异质性,在理论上可增加偏移和分布不匹配的术语(XQ a p (U)\epsilon * app} (U)和XQ g e n\epsilon * gen})和生成数据集上的风险最小化术语(R ^ k (U)\glawhat{R}_{k}(U))). 从理论上讲,如果一个地面真实数据集能够减少异质性,就能够产生更好的多重近似度指标和更强的脱钩效应。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This study investigated the effects of decoupling the interpolation and mapping tasks of a regular unmixing model on unmixing accuracy. It established the critical importance of including physical priors during the training of the generator model G G .
blocks.zh: 该研究调查了将定期不相混合模型的插入和绘图任务脱钩对不相混合准确性的影响. 它确定了在发电机型号G的培训过程中纳入物理前科的至关重要性。

blocks.en: This was demonstrated by the comparatively superior manifold approximation performance of GD-Streamline, incorporating several different physical priors during training, relative to TCVAE. However, it was also concluded that physical priors introduced during the training of the generator models, such as TV and SAM, were not entirely effective at improving the unmixing accuracy of the unmixing model U U trained on generated data, and that more rigorous physical priors were needed.
blocks.zh: 与TCVAE相比,GD-Streamline的多面相近性能相对较好,在培训期间吸收了几种不同的物理前科。 然而,也得出这样的结论:在发电机模型培训过程中引入的物理前科,如电视和SAM,对于提高未混合模型UU在所生成数据上培训的不混合精度并不完全有效,需要更严格的物理前科.

blocks.en: The mismatch in TCVAE’s R 2 R^{2} values indicates the difficulty of approximating the effects of NPV abundance condition in the ground-truth manifold. Conversely, comparisons with the GD-Streamline’s R 2 R^{2} values indicate that the KL-Divergence component in the TCVAE model was instrumental in approximating parts of the manifold.
blocks.zh: TCVAE 的 R 2 R^{2} 值中的不匹配, 说明在地- 实相多面中难以近似 NPV 丰度状态的效果 。 反之,与GD-Streamline的R 2 R^{2}的数值比较表明,TCVAE模型中的KL-Divergence元件有助于近似于多面体的部分.

blocks.en: Finally, the scaling of the generated dataset size ( k k ) is theoretically viable for decoupling, as in specific generator-unmixing model combinations (TCVAE and FNO, respectively), a positive correlation between dataset size and decoupling efficacy was observed.
blocks.zh: 最后,所生成的数据集大小(k k)的缩放在理论上是可行的去对接方式,因为在特定的发电机-去对接模型组合(分别为TCVAE和FNO)中,观察到了数据集大小与去对接效果之间的正相关.

blocks.en: 8.1 Future Work
blocks.zh: 8.1 今后的工作

blocks.en: 8.1.1 Non-Photosynthetic Vegetation Abundance Mapping:
blocks.zh: 8.1.1 非合成 植被丰度测绘:

blocks.en: Given the established difficulty in approximating the influence of NPV abundance on ground-truth manifolds, it is suggested that developing abundance mappings with greater expressivity with respect to class-wise differences may yield improvements in both generation and unmixing performance.
blocks.zh: 鉴于在接近NPV丰度对地面真象多面体的影响方面存在既定困难,因此,有人建议,以更明确的方式对不同等级的差异进行丰度测绘,可能会在生成和未混合性能方面带来改进。

blocks.en: 8.1.2 End-To-End Hyperparameter Tuning:
blocks.zh: 8.1.2 端到端高参数 调音 :

blocks.en: Due to development constraints, the two generative models were developed independently of the unmixing pipeline. Consequently, the hyperparameters of both models were tuned using visual heuristics and model-specific metrics, such as the TCVAE’s reconstruction loss. Given the sensitivity of model performance to hyperparameter selection, a promising direction for future work would be to optimize hyperparameters end-to-end against the metrics used in this study, rather than the two-stage development pipeline.
blocks.zh: 由于发展限制,两个基因模型是独立于不相混合的管道开发的. 因此,这两个模型的超参数都采用了视觉热度和模型特定度量衡,例如TCVAE的重建损失。 鉴于模型性能对超参数选择的敏感性,未来工作的一个有希望的方向是对照本研究中使用的衡量标准,而不是两阶段开发管道,优化超参数端到端。

blocks.en: 8.1.3 Flow-Matching Models:
blocks.zh: 8.1.3 流动匹配模式:

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated two classes of generative models: diffusion models and conditional variational autoencoders, and our empirical results demonstrate that the choice of model class has a notable effect on the characteristics of the generated output. Specifically, we observed a smoothing phenomenon in the outputs of our TCVAE model, whereas our Gaussian Diffusion model exhibited elevated noise in its generated spectra. We hypothesize that the limited volume of training data amplifies each model’s inductive bias in its generated output, as it must rely more heavily on its structural assumptions when the empirical signal is scarce. It would therefore be worthwhile to examine the generated outputs produced by flow-matching models, which offer a distinct set of inductive biases compared to the model classes studied here.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了两类基因模型:扩散模型和有条件的可变自编码器,我们的经验结果表明,模型类的选择对所生成输出的特性有显著影响. 具体地说,我们观测到我们的TCVAE模型的输出中呈现出平滑现象,而我们的高斯散射模型则在其产生的光谱上呈现出高噪. 我们假设培训数据的有限量会放大每个模型产生的产出的诱导性偏差,因为当经验信号稀少时,它必须更多地依赖其结构假设。 因此,值得审查流动匹配模型产生的产出,这些模型与此处研究的模型类相比,提供了一套独特的诱导偏差。
